title: REQ · Scheduler auto-opens and auto-closes rounds using an injected clock
summary: Clock-driven Tick that opens SCHEDULED and closes expired OPEN rounds
description: Context: nothing triggers open/close at scheduled times. Desired behavior: Scheduler.Tick uses an injected Clock to open SCHEDULED rounds whose starts_at has passed and close OPEN rounds whose ends_at has passed. Expected result: rounds change state without admin action. Why: continuous cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Given a SCHEDULED round with starts_at <= clock now, when Tick runs, then Open is called
Given an OPEN round with ends_at <= now, when Tick runs, then Close is called
Given times in the future, when Tick runs, then nothing is called
